ink.$description: Ink — Primary CTAs, primary text, active states. Used as the strongest dark tone, providing maximum contrast and visual weight for key actions.

action-blue.$description: Action Blue — Tertiary links, informational banner text. A rare, functional splash of color reserved for secondary calls to action and informational highlights.

white.$description: White — Card backgrounds, text on dark buttons.

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary text, descriptive copy, disabled states.

stone.$description: Stone — Placeholder text, decorative UI elements.

info-banner-bg.$description: Info Banner BG — Background for the top-of-page informational banner.

cal-sans.$description: Primary headline font. Its geometric forms and slightly wide stance give the brand a unique, technical-yet-friendly voice. Used exclusively for headings to establish hierarchy.

cal-sans-ui-variable-light.$description: Primary body and UI text font. The light weight and tight negative tracking create a clean, modern text block that is readable without being loud.

inter.$description: Secondary UI and body font. Used for smaller text, labels, and inside complex components like the calendar widget where utmost clarity is required.

matter.$description: Tertiary UI text for captions and metadata where a highly legible, neutral choice is needed.
